observation: Root sees a broad grey cloud around the bar; rails remain almost joined and both X ties insufficiently readable. Author view_image appeared almost empty despite valid colored RGB/alpha samples, while the ImageGen preview showed the broad cloud. The discrepancy is preserved as an observed preview limitation, not proof of corrupted PNG bytes.

ImageGen preview and independent root inspection show the complete extremely narrow horizontal steel segment, three post caps, two separated grey-olive rails and two continuous fine X ties. The broad low-alpha cloud of iteration2 is absent. Material is more uniformly metallic and the voids are clearer. The final source used the canonical alone; no earlier generated image was passed.
inspectionMethod: Author inspected the ImageGen native preview and decoded native alpha without modifying pixels; root independently viewed the saved candidate and canonical. Author view_image displayed almost no object, an observed viewer discrepancy retained below rather than a claim of corrupted PNG bytes.
limitations: Source-art proposal only; no runtime integration, pivot calibration, metric scale or collision validation.
Fine ties still require later engine-scale legibility review; no readability guarantee at every scale.
Residual very-low-alpha pixels are recorded, including diffuse alpha1 pixels. Exact zero alpha everywhere outside the silhouette is not claimed; borders are alpha0.
No crop, resize, cleanup, compositing or re-encoding. Native bytes preserved.
Surface details and exact proportions are interpretations, not pixel-for-pixel or metric 1:1 certification.
